title: Transgression ci tefes gi
intro: Yaa ngi taxaw ci kaw suuf si ci tefes guñ fatte, di barab bu vague yi di yuuxu ci askan wiñ natt ci ndigalu Yàlla. Air bi dafa diis ndax fàttaliku benn violation bu indi coppite bu yéeme. Kan ñooy ruuh yooyu, te naka lañu doon fitna?
clues: Nun askan la woon wu jot ndigal lu leer ci sunu Boroom, waaye gis nanu nu nu ko mëna jaare.
Danu dëkkoon ci wetu ndox, sunu dundin a ngi aju ci mbindéef yi ci nekk.
Bis bi ñu nu digal nu bàyyi topp mbiri àdduna, daf nu natt.
Bis boobu, mbindéef yi nekk ci ndox mi daal di ñëw ci nun, dinu fiir ba kenn mënul muñ.
Nu xalaat pexe bu jaarul yoon ngir moytu yoon wi Yàlla tëral, jàpp ni noo ngi raw yoon wi.
Sunu njuumte moo jur coppite bu gacce; nu nekk ay maymu yu ñuy xeex ci ndigalu Yàlla.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
